import math

# Convert percentages to decimal values
r1 = 8.072 / 100  # 0.08072
r2 = 10.260 / 100  # 0.10260

# Compute log of each rate
log_r1 = math.log(r1)
log_r2 = math.log(r2)

print(f"r1 (decimal): {r1}")
print(f"r2 (decimal): {r2}")
print(f"log(r1): {log_r1}")
print(f"log(r2): {log_r2}")

# Compute log return (difference)
log_return = log_r2 - log_r1
print(f"Log return: {log_return}")

# Compute realized variance (square of log return)
realized_variance = log_return ** 2
print(f"Realized variance: {realized_variance}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
rounded = round(realized_variance, 2)
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {rounded}")
EOF
